speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to start our assessment, how long have these symptoms been present, and do you notice any other changes in your mood, sleep, or movement?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive impairment or Dementia with Lewy Bodies. The asymmetric progression of tremors (starting in the left hand) followed by executive dysfunction and memory loss is characteristic of Parkinsonian syndromes, particularly Dementia with Lewy Bodies.
